TABLE audit_log
SQL CREATE TABLE audit_log (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin',   action TEXT NOT NULL,   entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,   entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,   note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   before_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',   after_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT

COLUMN 4|entity_id|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 5|note|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 6|before_json|TEXT|1|'{}'|0
COLUMN 7|after_json|TEXT|1|'{}'|0
COLUMN 8|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0

TABLE concept_facets
SQL CREATE TABLE concept_facets (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   concept_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES concepts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,   language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   facet_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (     facet_type IN ('name', 'rendering', 'description', 'note', 'alias', 'former_label')   ),   value TEXT NOT NULL,   source_crystal_id INTEGER REFERENCES crystals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,   confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.2 CHECK (confidence >= 0.0 AND confidence <= 1.0),   is_canonical INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_canonical IN (0, 1)),   superseded_at TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL,   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|id|INTEGER|0|NULL|1
COLUMN 1|concept_id|INTEGER|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 2|language|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 3|facet_type|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 4|value|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 5|source_crystal_id|INTEGER|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 6|confidence|REAL|1|0.2|0
COLUMN 7|is_canonical|INTEGER|1|0|0
COLUMN 8|superseded_at|TEXT|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 9|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 10|updated_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
FK 0|0|crystals|source_crystal_id|id|NO ACTION|SET NULL|NONE
FK 1|0|concepts|concept_id|id|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE

TABLE concepts
SQL CREATE TABLE concepts (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   canonical_name TEXT NOT NULL,   description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   scope_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'global',   scope_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'candidate' CHECK (     status IN ('candidate', 'established', 'archived', 'merged')   ),   confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.2 CHECK (confidence >= 0.0 AND confidence <= 1.0),   merged_into_concept_id INTEGER REFERENCES concepts(id),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL,   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,   CHECK (     (scope_type = 'global' AND scope_key = '')     OR (scope_type != 'global' AND scope_key != '')   ) ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|id|INTEGER|0|NULL|1
COLUMN 1|canonical_name|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 2|description|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 3|scope_type|TEXT|1|'global'|0
COLUMN 4|scope_key|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 5|status|TEXT|1|'candidate'|0
COLUMN 6|confidence|REAL|1|0.2|0
COLUMN 7|merged_into_concept_id|INTEGER|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 8|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 9|updated_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
FK 0|0|concepts|merged_into_concept_id|id|NO ACTION|NO ACTION|NONE

TABLE crystals
SQL CREATE TABLE crystals (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   crystal_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (     crystal_type IN ('lesson', 'rule', 'thought', 'observation', 'concept_note', 'concept', 'erudition')   ),   text TEXT NOT NULL,   title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   scope_type TEXT NOT NULL,   scope_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   series_slug TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   source_language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   target_language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',   strength REAL NOT NULL CHECK (strength >= 0.0 AND strength <= 1.0),   confidence REAL NOT NULL CHECK (confidence >= 0.0 AND confidence <= 1.0),   source_credibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'observation',   rule_intent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   soft_origin TEXT,   is_inferred INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_inferred IN (0, 1)),   malformed_penalty REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0 CHECK (malformed_penalty >= 0.0),   supersedes_crystal_id INTEGER REFERENCES crystals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,   status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (     status IN ('active', 'candidate', 'archived', 'rejected', 'superseded')   ),   created_cycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   last_activated_cycle INTEGER,   last_reinforced_cycle INTEGER,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL,   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|id|INTEGER|0|NULL|1
COLUMN 1|crystal_type|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 2|text|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 3|title|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 4|scope_type|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 5|scope_key|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 6|series_slug|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 7|source_language|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 8|target_language|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 9|tags_json|TEXT|1|'[]'|0
COLUMN 10|strength|REAL|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 11|confidence|REAL|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 12|source_credibility|TEXT|1|'observation'|0
COLUMN 13|rule_intent|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 14|soft_origin|TEXT|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 15|is_inferred|INTEGER|1|0|0
COLUMN 16|malformed_penalty|REAL|1|0.0|0
COLUMN 17|supersedes_crystal_id|INTEGER|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 18|status|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 19|created_cycle|INTEGER|1|0|0
COLUMN 20|last_activated_cycle|INTEGER|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 21|last_reinforced_cycle|INTEGER|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 22|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 23|updated_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
FK 0|0|crystals|supersedes_crystal_id|id|NO ACTION|SET NULL|NONE
INDEX 0|idx_crystals_maintenance|0|c|1|id

TABLE rag_chunks
SQL CREATE TABLE rag_chunks (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rag_sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,   series_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series(slug) ON DELETE CASCADE,   chunk_kind TEXT NOT NULL,   text TEXT NOT NULL,   display_text TEXT NOT NULL,   location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL,   FOREIGN KEY (source_id, series_slug)     REFERENCES rag_sources(id, series_slug) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|id|INTEGER|0|NULL|1
COLUMN 1|source_id|INTEGER|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 2|series_slug|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 3|chunk_kind|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 4|text|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 5|display_text|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 6|location|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 7|metadata_json|TEXT|1|'{}'|0
COLUMN 8|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
FK 0|0|rag_sources|source_id|id|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE
FK 0|1|rag_sources|series_slug|series_slug|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE
FK 1|0|series|series_slug|slug|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE
FK 2|0|rag_sources|source_id|id|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE
INDEX 0|rag_chunks_series_slug_idx|0|c|0|series_slug
INDEX 1|rag_chunks_source_id_idx|0|c|0|source_id
TABLE rag_sources
SQL CREATE TABLE rag_sources (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   series_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series(slug) ON DELETE CASCADE,   source_ref TEXT NOT NULL,   source_type TEXT NOT NULL,   content_type TEXT NOT NULL,   checksum TEXT NOT NULL,   metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',   created_at TEXT NOT NULL,   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,   UNIQUE (id, series_slug),   UNIQUE (series_slug, source_ref) ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|id|INTEGER|0|NULL|1

TABLE semantic_batch_claims
SQL CREATE TABLE semantic_batch_claims (   claim_token TEXT NOT NULL,   job_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semantic_index_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,   chunk_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rag_chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,   generation_id TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL, lease_expires_at TEXT, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (attempts >= 1),   PRIMARY KEY (claim_token, chunk_id),   UNIQUE (job_id, chunk_id) ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|claim_token|TEXT|1|NULL|1
COLUMN 1|job_id|INTEGER|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 2|chunk_id|INTEGER|1|NULL|2
COLUMN 3|generation_id|TEXT|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 4|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 5|lease_expires_at|TEXT|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 6|attempts|INTEGER|1|1|0
FK 0|0|rag_chunks|chunk_id|id|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE
FK 1|0|semantic_index_jobs|job_id|id|NO ACTION|CASCADE|NONE
INDEX 1|semantic_batch_claims_job_token_idx|0|c|0|job_id,claim_token
INDEX 0|semantic_batch_claims_lease_idx|0|c|0|job_id,lease_expires_at,chunk_id
INDEX 3|sqlite_autoindex_semantic_batch_claims_1|1|pk|0|claim_token,chunk_id
INDEX 2|sqlite_autoindex_semantic_batch_claims_2|1|u|0|job_id,chunk_id

TABLE task_sessions
SQL CREATE TABLE task_sessions (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   series_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series(slug),   source_language TEXT NOT NULL,   target_language TEXT NOT NULL,   task_type TEXT NOT NULL,   volume TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   chapter TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'dreamed')),   cycle_id INTEGER,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL,   last_activity_at TEXT NOT NULL,   completed_at TEXT ) STRICT
COLUMN 0|id|INTEGER|0|NULL|1
COLUMN 1|series_slug|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 2|source_language|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 3|target_language|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 4|task_type|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 5|volume|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 6|chapter|TEXT|1|''|0
COLUMN 7|status|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 8|cycle_id|INTEGER|0|NULL|0
COLUMN 9|created_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 10|last_activity_at|TEXT|1|NULL|0
COLUMN 11|completed_at|TEXT|0|NULL|0
FK 0|0|series|series_slug|slug|NO ACTION|NO ACTION|NONE
